summary: Tree and sequence sources exist for large genera (Open Tree node for Carex, 1,701 species-rank taxa in NCBI taxonomy, 7,627 BOLD specimens), but no ready-made table of within-genus trees or distances was found; a test would assemble them per genus.
next_step: Choose a few large genera (e.g. Carex, Astragalus, Solanum), pull Open Tree subtrees or dated trees from the original studies, and pre-register the imbalance statistics and the null model.
obstacles_confirmed: Incomplete taxon sampling in very large genera.
Open Tree flagged the Carex node as broken (non-monophyly in the synthetic tree).
